notes: JobsOhio's own release says Sheetz, Inc. was founded in Altoona, Pennsylvania in 1952, is still family-owned and headquartered there, and employs more than 25,000 people. The payee Sheetz Distribution Services, LLC is Sheetz's own subsidiary building a user-owned distribution and food-prep facility in Findlay (Hancock County, 750 jobs, $150 million investment), so the recipient is an operating convenience-store company, not a developer.

JobsOhio's release says EASE needed to acquire a new headquarters building in Dublin, with 145 jobs retained and 140 committed, so the parent is the operating logistics company itself and the employee count is in the 100-499 band. The $400,000 payment is a Revitalization Grant, but the money built EASE's own headquarters, so the row is classed business rather than site_development.

Wells Fargo & Company's FY2024 10-K reports approximately 217,000 active employees at December 31, 2024 and principal executive offices at 420 Montgomery Street, San Francisco, California. The payee is Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (the 990 lists a Charlotte, NC service address); JobsOhio's workforce grant supports a new financial services technology center in Franklin County.

Avery Dennison's 10-K for the year ended December 28, 2024 reports approximately 35,000 employees and corporate headquarters at 8080 Norton Parkway, Mentor, Ohio. The company (founded in Los Angeles in 1935) moved its headquarters from Glendale, California to Mentor in 2022, so an earlier grant year for a different Avery Dennison recipient is coded CA while this FY2025 row is coded OH; the award itself was a June 2021 workforce grant for the Painesville plant in Lake County.

Protiviti is the consulting subsidiary of Robert Half Inc., whose FY2024 10-K reports approximately 14,700 full-time internal staff and headquarters operations in Menlo Park and San Ramon, California (Protiviti's own administrative support is run from those two offices). The JobsOhio grants back a Hamilton County office with 450 committed jobs.

JobsOhio's release describes Welspun USA, Inc. as a subsidiary of India-based Welspun India Ltd. and 'a leading global manufacturer and distributor of home textiles' supplying nine of the top ten US retailers; the Indian parent (since renamed Welspun Living) is a listed textile group with tens of thousands of workers, but no filing giving an exact worldwide count was fetched, so the 5000+ bucket is graded C. The award is a December 2024 economic development grant for a Grove City (Franklin County) retrofit, 70 jobs created and 21 retained.

JobsOhio's release says Plaskolite is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio with over 2,000 employees at 18 locations worldwide; the company's own site says it was founded in Columbus in 1950 by Donald Dunn (https://www.plaskolite.com/about). Privately held and private-equity-backed since at least 2015 (Plastics News, 'Private equity firm buys stake in Ohio-based Plaskolite'); the current owner was not confirmed, so the parent is left as the operating company.

Novo Manufacturing LLC shares Novo Building Products' Zeeland, Michigan address, and novobp.com brands itself 'An ADENTRA Company'; Hardwoods Distribution Inc. (renamed ADENTRA in December 2022) completed the purchase of Novo Building Products from Blue Wolf Capital in August 2021, before this grant. ADENTRA's careers page says it has approximately 3,000 employees across 81 North American centers and a corporate office in Langley, British Columbia. The Ohio project is in Harrison County, where Novo owns the former L.J. Smith stair-parts plant in Bowerston (14 jobs created, 61 retained).
